run_vocoder_benchmark_cli: run the vocoder benchmarking CLI to train, synthesize, or evaluate speech synthesis models
train_wavegrad_model: train a WaveGrad vocoder model on a specified dataset with a given config path
synthesize_audio_wavegrad: synthesize audio waveforms from spectrograms using a trained WaveGrad model
evaluate_vocoder_model: evaluate a trained vocoder model on a dataset and compute quality metrics
download_dataset: download a supported TTS dataset such as ljspeech, libritts, or vctk
split_dataset: split a downloaded dataset into train, validation, and test subsets
train_diffwave_model: train a DiffWave vocoder model on a specified dataset with a given config path
train_wavernn_model: train a WaveRNN vocoder model on a specified dataset with a given config path
train_wavenet_model: train a WaveNet vocoder model on a specified dataset with a given config path
train_parallel_wavegan_model: train a ParallelWaveGAN vocoder model on a specified dataset with a given config path
